blocks.text: After breakfast, comfortable bus to Chivay and the Colca Canyon, one of the deepest and most beautiful canyons in the world. Stops along the way at scenic viewpoints, at Lagunillas lake with its pink flamingos and at a viewpoint over three volcanoes. Arrival in Chivay and check-in; lunch, and the hot springs if you wish.

blocks.text: After breakfast, drive about an hour and a half to the Cruz del Cóndor viewpoint to watch the flight of the Andean condor, whose wingspan reaches some 3 metres. Return to the hotel and depart for Arequipa, the “White City” among the volcanoes, with stops at the villages of Yanque and Maca and viewpoints over three volcanoes. Arrival, check-in and free time to explore the city.
